headline: 3 killed in gunfight between UPDF and JSS in Khagrachhari
summary: The clash between the United People's Democratic Front and Parbatya Chattagram Jana Samhati Samiti occurred in Panchari upazila over dominance.
details: Three people were killed in a gunfight between the United People's Democratic Front (UPDF-Main) and the Parbatya Chattagram Jana Samhati Samiti (JSS-Main) in Khagrachhari's Panchari upazila.
The incident took place this afternoon in Madhumangal Para of Chengi Union.
Panchari Police Station Officer-in-Charge Md Ferdous Wahid stated that the two rival groups exchanged gunfire over dominance, resulting in the three deaths.
Police have gone to the scene to recover the bodies, though the identities of the deceased have not yet been confirmed.
No statements were immediately available from either the UPDF (Main) or JSS (Main) regarding the clash.

headline_marked: Schoolgirl killed as [[stone-laden truck ploughs through house]] in Narail
headline: Schoolgirl killed as stone-laden truck ploughs through house in Narail
summary: A 14-year-old student was killed and her sister injured after a truck crashed into their home in Lohagara upazila while they were asleep.
details: A 14-year-old schoolgirl, Shamima Akter Setu, was killed and her 12-year-old sister, Mitu, was injured after a stone-laden truck crashed into their roadside house in Naldi village, Lohagara upazila of Narail.
The incident occurred around 12:30 am today, while the two sisters were asleep in their home.
Family members reported that the truck took a wrong turn onto a narrow road along a canal bank, lost control, and ploughed through the house.
The impact caused stones from the truck to fall onto the sisters, resulting in Setu's death and Mitu's injuries.
Mitu was treated at Narail District Hospital and has since returned home.
Lohagara Police Station inspector Ajit Kumar Roy stated that police have seized the truck, but the driver and helper have fled the scene and remain at large.
